title: Core Research
description: Domain-independent task, model, research-lever, evidence, and governance adapters.

adapters.title: Open research task
adapters.description: A task family that will be narrowed during evidence-led discovery.
discovery_questions: Which reproducible failure, tension, or constraint defines the task?
novelty_traps: Treating a renamed benchmark or domain transfer as a new task contribution.

adapters.title: Model-agnostic investigation
adapters.description: Research whose initial mechanism does not assume one model family.
discovery_questions: Which model assumptions are essential, and which should remain variable?
novelty_traps: Claiming model generality after testing one architecture.

adapters.title: Data and curriculum
adapters.description: Data construction, filtering, synthesis, augmentation, curricula, and sampling research.
discovery_questions: Which distributional defect or supervision bottleneck is causally limiting performance?
novelty_traps: Scaling data or applying standard filtering without a new mechanism or resource claim.

adapters.title: Representation and tokenization
adapters.description: Learned representations, tokenizers, codecs, discretization, and compression interfaces.
discovery_questions: What information is discarded, duplicated, or made difficult to optimize by the representation?
novelty_traps: Replacing one existing tokenizer or encoder without isolating a new interaction.

adapters.title: Architecture
adapters.description: New modules, connectivity, memory, routing, hierarchy, and cross-component interfaces.
discovery_questions: Which measured information-flow or capacity mismatch motivates an architectural intervention?
novelty_traps: A familiar block diagram assembled from known modules without a non-obvious interaction.

adapters.title: Optimization, post-training, and RL
adapters.description: Objectives, credit assignment, preference learning, reward models, and optimization dynamics.
discovery_questions: Which learning dynamic, reward mismatch, or credit-assignment failure is reproducible?
novelty_traps: Adding domain branding to PPO, DPO, distillation, or a standard loss reweighting.

adapters.title: Generation, decoding, and control
adapters.description: Sampling, decoding, conditioning, editing, controllability, and structured generation.
discovery_questions: Where does the generation process lose conditioning, structure, diversity, or controllability?
novelty_traps: Prompt engineering or sampler tuning presented as a new generation method.

adapters.title: Efficiency and systems
adapters.description: Algorithms, kernels, compilers, serving, scheduling, compression, and hardware co-design.
discovery_questions: Which measured stage dominates cost in which workload and hardware regimes?
novelty_traps: Component speedup without an end-to-end ceiling, matched quality, or a new system interaction.

adapters.title: Robustness and generalization
adapters.description: Distribution shift, low-resource transfer, adversarial conditions, calibration, and reliability.
discovery_questions: Which controlled shift exposes a stable and consequential failure?
novelty_traps: Adding another corruption benchmark without a mechanism or validated evaluation contribution.

adapters.title: Safety, privacy, and governance
adapters.description: Misuse, privacy, provenance, memorization, fairness, and responsible deployment research.
discovery_questions: What concrete threat model and observable harm define the research question?
novelty_traps: Generic safety discussion without a threat model, attack, defense, or measurement contribution.

adapters.title: Evaluation and empirical science
adapters.description: Benchmarks, metrics, reproducible phenomena, scaling laws, diagnostics, and causal analysis.
discovery_questions: Which accepted metric, benchmark, or empirical assumption fails under a controlled test?
novelty_traps: Metric proliferation or profiling that does not reveal a general and consequential phenomenon.

adapters.title: Theory and formal analysis
adapters.description: Formal objectives, guarantees, bounds, identifiability, and explanatory models.
discovery_questions: Which assumption mismatch or unexplained invariant supports a precise formal problem?
novelty_traps: A renamed theorem or bound whose proof and assumptions are unchanged from prior work.

adapters.title: Controlled experimental evidence
adapters.description: Matched baselines, real ground truth, seeds, ablations, negative controls, and stress tests.
discovery_questions: What cheapest controlled experiment distinguishes the causal alternatives?
novelty_traps: Treating one positive pilot or an unmatched baseline as publishable evidence.

adapters.title: Optimization-dynamics evidence
adapters.description: Reward validity, learning curves, collapse, KL and entropy, credit assignment, and seed stability.
discovery_questions: Which training signal separates optimization failure from data or evaluator failure?
novelty_traps: Reporting final quality without diagnosing reward hacking or training instability.

adapters.title: System measurement
adapters.description: Synchronized stage timing, warmup, memory, throughput, latency, cost, and end-to-end ceilings.
discovery_questions: Does the bottleneck persist across workload, model, and hardware regimes?
novelty_traps: Unsynchronized microbenchmarks or component-only speedups.

adapters.title: Empirical-discovery evidence
adapters.description: Predeclared phenomenon, cross-setting replication, falsifiers, and claim ceilings.
discovery_questions: What observation would make the claimed phenomenon disappear?
novelty_traps: Post-hoc slice mining or diagnostic observations presented as universal findings.

adapters.title: Formal evidence
adapters.description: Definitions, assumptions, proof obligations, counterexamples, and executable checks where possible.
discovery_questions: Which lemma, counterexample, or formal check is the shortest decisive witness?
novelty_traps: Informal intuition presented as a theorem or guarantee.

adapters.title: Safety and governance evidence
adapters.description: Explicit threat models, attack/defense protocols, subgroup analysis, provenance, and harm bounds.
discovery_questions: Which attack, misuse case, or affected population makes the harm measurable?
novelty_traps: Safety claims based only on benign benchmark averages.

adapters.title: Human evaluation
adapters.description: Blinded, randomized, documented human judgments with appropriate consent and statistical analysis.
discovery_questions: Which claim cannot be validated by a calibrated objective measure?
novelty_traps: Invented ratings, unblinded cherry-picked examples, or undocumented evaluator populations.

adapters.title: Inode-bounded persistence
adapters.description: Build and expand in jobfs, then publish a small number of packed durable artifacts.
discovery_questions: Can every dataset, environment, sample bundle, checkpoint, and log remain within the file envelope?
novelty_traps: Treating an expanded persistent tree as an acceptable implementation shortcut.
